## Details
### **SW-REQ-KMAT-001** — Fixed-Size Compile-Time Matrix Container

- **Description:** The kmat library shall provide a matrix container with compile-time-fixed dimensions.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013 and SW-REQ-SYS-050; nav uses a 16-state estimator and heap allocation is forbidden.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-050
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-KMAT-002** — Matrix Multiplication

- **Description:** The kmat library shall compute the product of two compatibly-dimensioned matrices.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013; nav 16-state estimator math requires matrix multiplication primitives.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-013
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-KMAT-003** — Matrix Transpose

- **Description:** The kmat library shall compute the transpose of a matrix.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013; nav 16-state estimator math requires matrix transpose primitives.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-013
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-KMAT-004** — Matrix Addition

- **Description:** The kmat library shall compute element-wise addition of two equally-dimensioned matrices.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013; nav 16-state estimator math requires matrix addition primitives.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active

- **Children:** None
